title: RFC005 S4 Run Manifest
$comment: Closed envelope for one S4 discovery run: the identity under which it may execute (design §7.1). `run_id` is derived from every other field (addendum A, the same construction s1_run_manifest / s2_run_manifest use). S4 has no run-manifest shape of its own for cache identity, allowlist or ancestry -- those bindings are carried by naming a companion S1-format run manifest by hash, exactly as s2_run_manifest does. `typed_integer_codec` is pinned `direct_regression` (D5); `grad_clip_micro` deliberately does NOT appear here -- it lives only in run_config.json (design §7.1, [governance R1]).

run_id.$comment: make_id("s4run", "rfc005.s4-run-id/v1", payload without run_id and without the self-hash). Derived, never assigned.

run_seed.$comment: The seed the ordered exposure plan (reused from S2) was built under.

binding_s1_run_manifest_hash.$comment: The companion S1-format run manifest's own s1_run_manifest_hash, re-derived by the builder from the presented companion document -- never a caller-typed value.

typed_supervision_census_hash.$comment: The frozen s4_typed_census.json's own census_hash, re-derived by the builder from the presented document.

heads_frozen_for_no_supervision.$comment: Explicit, may be empty. A head listed here whose census family-bearing supervised count is at or above min_supervised_per_head is an unused freeze and is refused by the builder (DEC-027 D2 rule).

low_supervision_pointers_disclosed.$comment: Explicit, may be empty (design §9 R8, §10.1 T8 point 4, fix loop 2). Every typed_head_config.new_supervised_pointers() entry whose census supervised count is below typed_supervision_floor.min_supervised_per_pointer must be named here by its pointer_supervision_key() string, or the manifest refuses to freeze -- the pre-existing head-level floor is computed over expert_adapter.dense's AGGREGATE, so a single new pointer with almost no supervision would otherwise pass silently inside it. Unlike heads_frozen_for_no_supervision, this field gates NO parameter at training time (a pointer's head_id is a whole group shared by many pointers, and step 6 (unfreeze_and_refreeze_typed_heads) plus the stage-policy states operate per head_id, so pointer-granularity freezing sits outside the head-group policy model -- mechanically a child module could be frozen, the policy has no way to express it) -- it is a pure disclosure requirement, named 'disclosed' rather than 'frozen' on purpose. A pointer listed here whose count actually meets the floor is a stale disclosure, refused too (the same DEC-027 D2 rule, applied to a coverage claim rather than a frozen parameter). new_supervised_pointers() is restricted to what s4_typed_census can actually measure a real supervised count for (today: the 21 colour pointers) -- the /layout/tabs cardinality count and the 4 border-object pointers are excluded and disclosed in the design doc, not measured as a fabricated zero.

lr_reduced_micro.$comment: Integer thousandths of the reduced learning rate applied to tree_text_decoder (house style: lr_micro).

init_from.$comment: Warm-start pin (design §6) or null for a clean run. parent_run_class is never caller-supplied at admission: it is re-derived here from the presented parent companion manifest, whose own hash must equal parent_s1_run_manifest_hash.

parent_run_id.$comment: s3run_ (design §6 warm start from S3) or s4run_ (RFC005-ERRATA-012: the LR tail warm-starts from a checkpoint of the clean-start S4 promotion run itself). Widening only -- every earlier manifest still validates.

typed_head_config_hash.$comment: typed_head_config.typed_head_config_hash() at build time (design §7 rev 3, §9 R12/R13, T8): the caps/palette/vocabularies/star-pointer configuration the run's typed heads are bound to. Re-derived by the builder, never a caller-typed value; also required inside the bound census payload's own fields (_verify_census) and compared against the warm-start checkpoint's own stamped value (s4_train.load_init_weights).

selection_policy_hash.$comment: 1.1.0, RFC005-ERRATA-005 E3: s4_selection_policy.s4_selection_policy_hash() of the presented selection policy. REQUIRED (via this schema's own if/then) and never a placeholder floor for run_class=promotion; optional, bindable but never required, for discovery. Absent from the unconditional required list on purpose -- a discovery manifest frozen under the prior 1.0.0 schema never wrote this key and must still load.

mask_inactive_union_arms.$comment: 1.2.0, RFC005-ERRATA-008 E1 (PROPOSED, v16 only): whether s4_train's collate_typed drops a typed leaf not REQUIRED by its node's recorded union arm. Absent from the unconditional required list on purpose -- a manifest frozen under the prior 1.1.0 schema never wrote this key at all and must still load; s4_train.main() treats an absent key as false. The running v15b promotion must never pick this up from a bare git pull, so it stays an explicit opt-in bound here and cross-checked against s4_train's own --mask-inactive-union-arms flag on every invocation, including --resume.

consistency_lambda_milli.$comment: 1.3.0, RFC004-ERRATA-004 item R3 (draft RFC004-ERRATA-006, v16 only): integer thousandths of the R3 consistency term's own weight (s4_typed_loss.s4_total_loss's consistency_lambda; house style: _milli), separate from stage_policy's loss_weights_milli. Absent from the unconditional required list on purpose -- a manifest frozen under a prior schema never wrote this key at all and must still load; s4_train.main() treats an absent key as 0 (off). Cross-checked against s4_train's own --consistency-lambda flag on every invocation, including --resume, the same way mask_inactive_union_arms is.

level_router_policy_hash.$comment: 1.4.0, RFC007 variant B (PROPOSED, v16 only): level_router.policy.LevelRouterPolicy.policy_hash() of the grammar-conditioned query-side level router this run trains. Written ONLY when the router is selected (and the schema version is then 1.4.0); absent means no router, the v15b model. Cross-checked against s4_train's own --level-router-policy on every invocation, including --resume.

structural_table_region.$comment: 1.4.0, DEC-055 V6b (v16 dense fallback): written ONLY when 'exclude' -- absent means the v15b region channel (abstain_not_visible). Cross-checked against s4_train --structural-table-region on every invocation, including --resume.

data_quality_gate_hash.$comment: 1.4.0, DEC-057 point 6: the passing data-quality gate result's gate_result_hash binding the v16 caches this run uses (quality_gate.gate.require_data_quality_gate). Written ONLY for caches built under a v16 target policy; absent == a pre-v16 run. s4_train re-derives it from --data-quality-gate and the caches on every invocation.

lr_schedule.$comment: 1.4.0, dormant LR tail (model.lr_schedule): a linear_tail that holds the CLI base LRs up to start_step, then falls linearly to floor_milli/1000 of them on the run's last step. Written ONLY when selected; absent means the constant LR every earlier frozen run used. Cross-checked against s4_train --lr-schedule* on every invocation, including --resume.

visual_input.$comment: 1.4.0, DEC-056 addendum A (v16): the on-the-fly ViT path -- visual_input_policy_hash (onfly_visual.VisualInputPolicy.policy_hash: ViT revision, DeepStack taps, dtype, processor, pixel budget), the checkpoint's visual_feature_tap, and the per-draw augmentation seed + DEC-040 policy hash (null = no augmentation). Written ONLY for an on-the-fly run; absent means cached features (v15b).

external_views.$comment: task 6 (external-views.v1 continuation): written ONLY by a child bound with state_continuation.kind external-views.v1; a fresh freeze never writes it.

feature_cache.$comment: Fresh S4 (DEC-058) fallback, present only when on: clean views are served from the epoch-1 write-through fp8 cache (onfly_visual.ViTFeatureCache), so epochs 2+ train on the fp8 round trip.

batch_pages.$comment: Fresh S4 knob, present only when on: one tower call per multi-page batch.

collapsed_region_rule.$comment: 1.5.0, RFC004-ERRATA-012 E1 (v17): written ONLY when 'exclude' -- absent means abstain_container (v16). Cross-checked against s4_train --collapsed-region-rule on every invocation, including --resume.

story_decision_weight_milli.$comment: 1.5.0, RFC004-ERRATA-012 E3 (v17): thousandths weight of the story-decision positions in L_structure. Written ONLY when != 1000; absent means 1000 (v16). minimum 1, never 0: a zero weight would turn a present label into 'no label'.

alignment_type_weights_milli.$comment: 1.5.0, RFC004-ERRATA-012 E2 (v17): L_alignment weight per events_vocab node type, in thousandths. Written ONLY when non-empty. Each value minimum 1, never 0: a zero would turn a present label into 'no label' and an all-zero batch would divide 0/0. The node-type vocabulary is checked by the builder (events_vocab), not duplicated here.

page_uniform_boost.$comment: 1.5.0, RFC004-ERRATA-012 / design §4.3 (v17): the boost block of the page-uniform plan sidecar (sets_sha256, factor, draws). Written ONLY when the sidecar has a boost; the plan hash already covers the draws, s4_train cross-checks this block against the sidecar.
